limitations: Observed repeatability is not a proof of bit-level or future determinism.
Missing token IDs are unknown; this harness does not retokenize to invent provider IDs.
Transport-call overlap excludes preflight hashing but is not proof of same server batch or GPU schedule.
Changed-seed equality does not by itself prove that seed was ignored.
Endpoint-to-replica mapping is supplied by the operator, not discovered.
No task scores or paper performance are measured.
Usage totals are null when any attempt lacks reported usage; known sums include failed attempts.
